title: HELP ME MAKE IT THROUGH THE NIGHT
lyrics_synced:
[00:13.10] Take the ribbon from my hair,
[00:19.24] shake it loose and let it fall.
[00:25.40] Layin' soft against your skin,
[00:31.54] like the shadows on the wall.
[00:37.70] Come and lay down by my side
[00:43.85] till the early mornin' light.
[00:50.01] All I'm takin' is your time.
[00:56.17] Help me make it thru the night.
[01:02.30] I don't care what's right or wrong,
[01:08.28] and I won't try to understand.
[01:14.60] Let the devil take tomorrow.
[01:20.76] Lord, tonight I need a friend.
[01:26.92] Yesterday is dead and gone,
[01:33.08] and tomorrow's out of sight.
[01:39.24] And it's sad to be alone.
[01:45.39] Help me make it thru the night.
[01:51.53] Mmmmm
[01:57.71] Mmmmmm
[02:03.86] And it's sad to be alone.
[02:09.99] Help me make it thru the night.
[02:16.15] I don't want to be alone.
[02:22.31] Help me make it thru the night.%-%+
